hunks.baseline: Before the laws of time, all things were equal.
hunks.sol: Before the passage of time, all things are equal.

hunks.baseline: Even an absolute ruler who once commanded the world would one day return to the earth. A seed carried on the wind and buried in the soil might grow, hundreds of years later, into a dense thicket of grass.
hunks.sol: Even an absolute ruler who once commanded the world will one day return to the earth. A seed scattered by the wind and mixed into the soil may, hundreds of years later, become part of a dense thicket of grass.

hunks.baseline: Deep-rooted trees that had never been uprooted in the past several hundred years, even when they swayed.
hunks.sol: Deep-rooted trees that had swayed but never been uprooted in hundreds of years.

hunks.baseline: I snickered as I watched Ju Wongong hastily change his tune.
hunks.sol: I let out a short laugh as I watched Ju Wongong hastily change his tune.

hunks.baseline: My concern must have shown on my face. Ju Wongong went pale and urged the coachman on.
hunks.sol: The thought must have shown on my face. Ju Wongong went pale and urged the coachman on.

hunks.baseline: “It’s not that urgent. Don’t hassle the poor guy for doing his job. You should worry about yourself.”
hunks.sol: “It’s not that urgent. Don’t hassle a man who’s already doing his job. Worry about yourself.”

hunks.baseline: This feeling of controlling an avatar was surprisingly fun.
hunks.sol: Controlling an avatar like this was surprisingly fun.

hunks.baseline: Well, I had saved his life, and he was easy to handle. Keeping him on friendly terms could come in handy.
hunks.sol: Well, I had saved his life, and he was easy to handle. Keeping up a connection with him could come in handy.

hunks.baseline: I blinked and asked him back.
hunks.sol: I blinked at him.

hunks.baseline: “As you know, we’ve got elderly people and sick people in our party. I figured it’d be more comfortable if we had one. And when we’re out on the road, people are more likely to clear the way.”
hunks.sol: “As you know, we’ve got someone elderly and someone sick in our party. I figured a carriage would make things easier. People will clear the way for us on the streets, too.”

hunks.baseline: It’s an imperial carriage, can we really do this? No, it’s all right, I’m fine, and so on—one model answer after another.
hunks.sol: *It’s an imperial carriage, can we really do this? No, it’s all right, I’m fine.* One model answer after another.

hunks.baseline: Namho started, muttering just loud enough for everyone to hear and patting his lower back. The Fire Dragon Pavilion members climbed down from their horses and filed into the carriage.
hunks.sol: Namho started, muttering as if he wanted to be heard and patting his waist. The Fire Dragon Pavilion members climbed down from their horses and filed into the carriage.

hunks.baseline: This feeling of controlling an avatar really was a lot of fun.
hunks.sol: Controlling an avatar like this really was a lot of fun.

hunks.baseline: The first to greet us when we reached the Sichuan Tang Clan were the gate guard’s gruff voice and wary eyes, watching from atop the newly built stone wall.
hunks.sol: The first to greet us when we reached the Sichuan Tang Clan were the gruff voice and wary eyes of a gate guard stationed atop the newly built stone wall.

hunks.baseline: As the massive iron gate swung open, the gate guard smacked the dim-witted new recruit on the back of the head. He clasped his hands to me several times, then rushed off somewhere in a panic.
hunks.sol: As the massive iron gate swung open, the gate guard smacked the clueless new recruit on the back of the head. He clasped his hands in salute to me several times, then rushed off somewhere in a panic.

hunks.baseline: “It’s a pleasure to see you again. Thanks to you, the disciples of our sect avoided a great many casualties.”
hunks.sol: “It’s a pleasure to see you again. Thanks to you, the Disciples of our sect were spared heavy losses.”

hunks.baseline: At the sight of that enormous crowd surging in like a sea of people, Namho gaped.
hunks.sol: Namho gaped at the enormous crowd surging toward us.

hunks.baseline: “Even so, this is… It’s strange enough that people from other sects are here with the Sichuan Tang Clan, who are famous for their foul tempers. But why are they all coming out to greet you like this?”
hunks.sol: “Even so, this is… It’s strange enough that people from other sects are here with the Sichuan Tang Clan, who are famous for their foul tempers. But why are they all coming out like this?”

hunks.baseline: I kept bowing my head as cheers and clasped-hand greetings poured in from every direction. A warm feeling stirred in a corner of my heart.
hunks.sol: I kept bowing my head as cheers and clasped-hand greetings poured in from every direction. Something tickled at a corner of my heart.

hunks.baseline: The sky, once blanketed in black smoke from the fires that burned countless bodies day after day, was clear without a single cloud. Beneath it stood rows of pavilions rebuilt through everyone’s help and hard work.
hunks.sol: The sky, once blanketed in black smoke from the fires that cremated countless bodies day after day, was clear without a single cloud. Beneath it stood rows of pavilions rebuilt through everyone’s help and hard work.

hunks.baseline: They had stopped the invisible rift that had persisted all this time, coming together to rise above their grief.
hunks.sol: They had put a stop to the divisions that had persisted unseen all this time. They had come together and were rising above their grief.

hunks.baseline: And they heard the warm voice of that old man—a voice no one there had ever heard before.
hunks.sol: And they heard warmth in his voice—warmth no one there had ever heard from him before.

hunks.baseline: The unexpected courtesy was so profound that I was at a loss for words. Tang Sadok clasped his hands in a formal salute, his sincerity plain, then smiled at me.
hunks.sol: The unexpected courtesy left me at a loss for words. Tang Sadok clasped his hands in a sincere salute, then looked at me and smiled.

hunks.baseline: At that one line, filled with the old man’s joy, the suppressed cheers rang out thunderously.
hunks.sol: At those few words, filled with the old man’s joy, the suppressed cheers rang out thunderously.
